yakit.AutoInitYakit()

# Input your code!

target = cli.String("target", cli.setHelp("填写url或域名"), cli.setRequired(true))
cli.check()
domain=target
try{
    #解析出根域名
    domain=str.ExtractDomain(target)[0]
}catch err{
    yakit.Info(string(err)+" 解析域名失败")
    #尝试解析出IP
    domain=str.ExtractHost(target)
}

search=f`域名
site:${domain}

title关键词
site:${domain} intitle:身份证|sfz|学号|xh|登录|注册|管理|平台|验证码|账号|系统|手册|默认密码|初始密码|password|联系电话|操作手册|vpn|名单

body关键词
site:${domain} intext:身份证|sfz|学号|xh|登录|注册|管理|平台|验证码|账号|系统|手册|默认密码|初始密码|password|联系电话|操作手册|vpn|名单

文件类型（文件类型不支持｜，需要拆分出来单独查询）
site:${domain} filetype:pdf
site:${domain} filetype:xlsx
site:${domain} filetype:pdf
site:${domain} filetype:xls
site:${domain} filetype:xlsx
site:${domain} filetype:docx
site:${domain} filetype:doc
site:${domain} filetype:text
site:${domain} filetype:ini
site:${domain} filetype:mdb
site:${domain} filetype:txt

SQL注入
site:${domain} inurl:aspx|asp|php|jsp|do|.action|html

文件路径
site:${domain} inurl:login|admin|manage|sysadmin|system|master|admin_login|cms|data|templates|index

文件上传
site:${domain} inurl:file|upload|uploadfile|ewebeditor|kindediter|Ueditor|file|choosefile

 -----------------------------目录穿越-----------------------------
intitle:index.of "parent directory"
intitle:index of /ppt
intitle:index of /password
intext:转到父目录/转到父路径
intext:to parent directory

 -----------------------------业务相关性-----------------------------
site:${domain} "审计报告" "身份证" "SFZ"
site:${domain} "财务报告" "身份证" "SFZ"
site:${domain} "科技奖" "身份证" "SFZ"
site:${domain} "发明专利" "身份证" "SFZ"
site:${domain} "财务报告" "身份证" "SFZ"
site:${domain} "无犯罪记录" "身份证" "SFZ"
site:${domain} "特发此证" "身份证" "SFZ"
site:${domain} "出版合同" "身份证" "SFZ"
site:${domain} "甲方代表" "身份证" "SFZ"
site:${domain} "乙方代表" "身份证" "SFZ"
site:${domain} "籍贯" "身份证" "SFZ"
site:${domain} "汉族" "身份证" "SFZ"
site:${domain} "职称" "身份证" "SFZ"

-----------------------------在谷歌上搜索github-----------------------------

邮箱配置信息泄露
site:github.com "${domain}" smtp password
site:github.com "${domain}" smtp @126.com
site:github.com "${domain}" String password smtp


数据库信息泄露
site:github.com  "${domain}" root password
site:github.com  "${domain}" sa password
site:github.com  "${domain}" User ID='sa';Password

svn信息泄露
site:github.com  "${domain}" svn
site:github.com  "${domain}" svn password
site:github.com  "${domain}" svn username
site:github.com  "${domain}" svn username password

数据库备份文件
site:github.com  "${domain}" inurl:sql


综合信息泄露
site:github.com  "${domain}" password
site:github.com  "${domain}" ftp ftppassword
site:github.com  "${domain}" 密码
site:github.com  "${domain}" 内部

-----------------------------在github上搜索-----------------------------

按关键字搜索
${domain} root 
${domain} 默认账号
${domain} 密码
${domain} VPN 账号

 按域名与代码片段搜索：
${domain} "/main/13527222xxxx.js"

 按github搜语法搜索:
in:name ${domain}               #仓库标题搜索含有关键字 
in:descripton ${domain}          #仓库描述搜索含有关键字
in:readme ${domain}              #Readme文件搜素含有关键字
stars:>3000 ${domain}            #stars数量大于3000的搜索关键字
stars:1000..3000 ${domain}       #stars数量大于1000小于3000的搜索关键字
forks:>1000 ${domain}            #forks数量大于1000的搜索关键字
forks:1000..3000 ${domain}       #forks数量大于1000小于3000的搜索关键字
size:>=5000 ${domain}            #指定仓库大于5000k(5M)的搜索关键字
pushed:>2019-02-12 ${domain}     #发布时间大于2019-02-12的搜索关键字
created:>2019-02-12 ${domain}    #创建时间大于2019-02-12的搜索关键字
user:${domain}                   #用户名搜素
license:apache-2.0 ${domain}     #明确仓库的 LICENSE 搜索关键字
language:java ${domain}          #在java语言的代码中搜索关键字
user:test in:name ${domain}      #组合搜索,用户名test的标题含有test的
`

yakit.EnableText("谷歌搜索语法")
yakit.TextTabData("谷歌搜索语法",search)
yakit.Text(search)
author: TAI
